description: Turn a correction to a Borgo figure, rule or source into a proposal the maintainers review, checked the way the project's GitHub workflow checks it: the target exists, the value has the metric's shape and unit, the citation is an official text (statute, gazette, official table or page, or a registry source) and not a link-only site, a rule cites its legal text, and the cited page answers and holds the quote. Returns the verdict and a prefilled GitHub issue link for the person to open and submit (public, under their account, data under CC BY 4.0). Posts nothing by itself: to post with the person's signed-in GitHub CLI, show them the proposal and call again with post.confirm set to the token this call returns, only after they say yes.

citation.description: The primary citation: the official text itself

quote.description: A sentence copied exactly from the page that states the value; checked on the page

type.description: statute, gazette, official-table, official-page or registry; news and other pages go in leads

city.description: For a figure: the city id (search_cities)

file.description: For a rule, source or link: the file, e.g. src/tax/it.ts or registry/ons-pipr.json (list_stale gives it)

kind.description: correction (a figure shown is wrong), figure (a figure Borgo lacks), rule-change (a tax, leave, residence or law rule), source (a registry entry), link (a broken or missing address)

leads.description: News or other pages that pointed to the change: leads, never citations

metric.description: For a figure: the metric id

note.description: For the reviewer; public, so no personal details

operator.description: The person or project that runs you and answers for the proposal

path.description: For a rule, source or link: what inside the file changes, e.g. ABORTION.US-NY or homepage

period.description: The time the value describes, e.g. 2026-09

post.description: Only after the person agreed to post this exact proposal: the confirm token from the previous call

proposed.description: A figure in the metric's unit (12 numbers for a monthly one), or the new rule in a sentence

source.description: For a figure: the registry source id it comes from (get_city shows it)

name: propose_change
title: Propose a correction
